artist RJ creates digital paintings and looping animations exploring everyday life and our increasingly complicated relationship with technology.  His deliberately simple visual language is part of the work. RJ primarily paints using minimal browser-based programs, then uses compression and animation to create images that feel flattened, fragmented and unmistakably connected to the aesthetics of the internet.  His characters inhabit strangely familiar situations: scrolling through phones, sitting alone, socializing, travelling or simply passing time. Ordinary moments become short, endlessly repeating digital scenes. #art #avantgarde #artist #weird #niche
